reason: Preference modes win over any theme (integrator feedback 0.1.3, item 1). Each token a mode reassigns gets a mode token holding its value under the mode, --ki-contrast-more-* (25) and --ki-reduced-transparency-* (12): the mode re-points the token to it with !important on the root and on theme roots, and a theme chooses its own mode values by setting the mode token. Additive: no token is removed or renamed and every existing token keeps its value in every context, except the deprecated --ki-select-listbox-backdrop-blur, which no mode reassigns any more (a deprecated token gets no mode token) and keeps its standard length under reduced transparency and more contrast in the default stylesheet; the listbox filter that replaced it still turns off. Behaviour change: a theme that restated a mode token under the mode's media query or declaration now loses to the mode and sets the mode token instead.
